### Guilty of Double-dealing
Author: Truth For Life
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-november-14-2015.html
Passage: Zephaniah 1:4-5
Points:
- God detests religious hypocrisy and will judge those who attempt to worship both Him and idols.
- Dividing allegiance between the Lord and worldly sins is an abhorrent compromise.
- Divine justice rightly falls upon people who profess the truth while cherishing evil in their hearts.
- Believers must honestly examine whether their faith is genuine or merely an outward pretense.
- Christ demands complete allegiance, leaving no space in the human heart for rival masters.
